caveat: A massing model, not CAD. The Raspberry Pi and HAT outlines and the case are published mechanical figures; every other body is an approximation sized to show scale and stacking. Nothing here has been built or measured.

bodies.note: Raspberry Pi 5 mechanical spec: 85 x 56 mm board, ~18 mm to the top of the Ethernet jack.

bodies.note: Pelican 1500 published dimensions. Exterior 434 x 332 x 157 mm, interior 425 x 284 x 155 mm. The model used to be drawn from the exterior alone, which answers how big the box is and not the question anyone actually has, which is whether the node fits in it.
